name: Microgrid storage discharge-power limit interface
summary: Receives the declared maximum permitted discharge power for the assigned storage resource.
description: Receives the declared maximum permitted discharge power for the assigned storage resource. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Storage discharge limit” at the input and “Permitted discharge capability” at the output. Energy availability is a separate constraint.
